pp_angle: Lio agents operate autonomously across ERP systems, contracts, supplier databases, and email — exactly the kind of high-stakes, multi-system access that enterprise risk and compliance teams lose sleep over. When an agent can negotiate terms, approve POs, and onboard suppliers, you need more than a system prompt to prove it acted correctly. Permission Protocol gives every Lio agent action a cryptographic authorization receipt *before* it executes — an audit trail that legal, finance, and enterprise security teams can trust. This turns PP from an add-on into a sales accelerator for Lio's enterprise deals.
